changelog: Theme songs found by searching YouTube now work; before, every search came back empty. Themes downloaded while 1.4.9.0 used Plex's theme server are deleted and fetched again from ThemerrDB and YouTube. Includes 1.4.10.0: a home card for a title in your library opens its library page from Info and Play. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
